subject: App works locally but has slight problem when deployed

messages.author: 1e582881857b84b4
messages.subject: App works locally but has slight problem when deployed
parts:
Hi all,

I built a small program to put markers on a map based on incidents. It can be found here: https://benhuynh.shinyapps.io/markermap/
My problem is that when using it on the shinyapps server, the year filter does not work. Changing the year to anything other than 'All' causes all the markers to disappear. When running locally, the year filter works exactly as intended. 

Any help would be greatly appreciated.

Thanks!

messages.author: 3da48b33a2f506a9
messages.subject: Re: App works locally but has slight problem when deployed
parts:
Hi,

You can use shinyapps::showLogs() command to see if there is any errors that might be causing this behavior.

On the server side I see the following messages which might help you troubleshoot the problem:

Loading required package: rCharts
Note: the specification for class “Datamaps” in package ‘rMaps’ seems equivalent to one from package ‘rCharts’: not turning on duplicate class definitions for this class.
Note: the specification for class “Leaflet” in package ‘rMaps’ seems equivalent to one from package ‘rCharts’: not turning on duplicate class definitions for this class.

Attaching package: ‘rMaps’

The following objects are masked from ‘package:rCharts’:

    Datamaps, Leaflet, makeChoroData, processChoroData, rqMap


We could take a look at your code, if you like to share it.

Also for future, the following discussion forum is a better one for shinyapps.io questions and issues:

https://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/shinyapps-users


Best,
Fereshteh
